items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report; Schefter notes expected to play, Donald OUT.
items.implication: WR1 upside returns; possible snap limits per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Primary routes/targets in Rams offense vs depleted Eagles secondary/pass rush.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN; good to go after hamstring.
items.why: ETR IN list; Rapoport/Texans PR confirm good to go.
items.implication: Elite WR1 in favorable DvP vs Cowboys.
items.opportunity: High target share; Cowboys inflate WR scoring 7.3% most in NFL per Levitan.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT; also AD Mitchell etc.
items.why: Schefter comprehensive OUT list; Rapoport Jets ruled out; ETR OUT.
items.implication: Jets RB committee or backup lead.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries to backups like Braelon Allen per Berry notes.

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams due to hamstring; Goedert also OUT.
items.why: Schefter/Eagles report; ETR OUT; Berry reacted with sigh.
items.implication: Eagles offense significantly worse sans Smith/Goedert/Baun per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining pass-catchers; Hurts rushing upside.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Sunday due to sprained ankle.
items.why: Schefter/Vikings report; ETR OUT list; Rapoport confirms.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison primary beneficiary home vs weak secondary.

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua back (hip); speculation on limited snaps, we'll see.
items.implication: Monitor snap count early; still high upside.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets if unrestricted vs Eagles sans key defenders.

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring by 7.3% (most NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: DvP data + implied total + return from hamstring.
items.opportunity: High target volume in positive game script potential.

items.text: Moment Jordan Addison truthers waiting for: home vs borderline NFL secondary with Jefferson out.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes in MIN offense.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL per reports).
items.why: ETR OUT; broader reports IR season-ending.
items.implication: MIA RB vacuum for rest of season.

items.text: Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet also OUT but practicing.
items.why: ETR OUT; Levitan details role erosion + injury.
items.implication: SEA RB role further fragmented short-term.
items.opportunity: Emmanuel Wilson GL, Holani pass downs; long-term Price eye-test positive.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
items.opportunity: Near-full snap/carry share with Dowdle OUT.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love LOVE: 26 touches last week (RB5 util); NYG allow 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
items.opportunity: High touches + targets vs soft run D.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing. Passes eye test long-term though.
items.why: Multiple role losses + injury + competition returning to practice.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: low util (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42%; SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
